description: TLV device-record parser whose name buffer size comes from config.h, force-included by the Makefile with -include

bugs.trigger: tlv_parse: a type-1 record with length byte 48..64 and that many printable bytes; the length is checked against the protocol limit TLV_NAME_MAX (64) but config.h shrinks char name[TLV_NAME_BUF] to 48 (stack overflow in memcpy, or in the NUL store when the length is 48)

decoys.why: internal helper in lib/ (not in include/), always called after an l == 2 length check; called directly with an arbitrary offset it reads out of bounds

lexer_expected: The lexer keeps only -I/-D flags and never sees -include config.h (no source includes it), so module 'tlv' compiles with the header default TLV_NAME_BUF 128 and S04-1 cannot trigger (verified: the repro does not abort without -include config.h). It also offers be16_at and all_printable as entry points of module 'lib'; the be16_at harness crashes at lib/bytes.c:6 (false positive, verified).
